**MPC TOOLS 1.5.12**

Tested working on an MPC One with standard Akai firmware 3.10.1 and with the latest HAKAI firmware (USB-boot method).

- **HAKAI fix, second pass.** MPC TOOLS now merges its addins into HAKAI's own `zz-hakai-gen1.conf` LD_PRELOAD list (via a `zzz-mpc-tools-addins.conf` drop-in that sorts after it) instead of trying to drive HAKAI through the stock launcher. This fixes the Remote tab failing after a HAKAI reboot with "The MPC app restarted, but MPC Remote still didn't start."

- **Windows:** `MPC-TOOLS-1.5.12-windows-x64.exe`

- **Mac:** `MPC-TOOLS-1.5.12-mac.zip` (not yet tested on a real Mac. On first open use System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway)

- `SHA256SUMS` to check the files
